criteria.criterion: Distinguish nominal registration, structural syntax compatibility and semantic interface laws; explain which C function-pointer mismatches need diagnostics and which wrong implementations still type-check.
criteria.scope: Nominal and structural conformance versus semantic laws
limits: C and Rust typing do not prove callback semantic laws.

criteria.criterion: Implement typed view constructors and a checked erased call wrapper with exactly-once callback invocation, stable table lifetime and failure-output staging.
criteria.scope: Exactly-once staged erased calls and typed receivers
limits: Trusted callbacks must obey write extents and owner lifetime.

criteria.criterion: Generate values and error callbacks against an independent direct-call model, reject incompatible signature/receiver translations and kill status-erasure and wrong-result mutants.
criteria.scope: Direct oracle and strict signature controls
limits: 34 direct-call and102 copy rows are finite falsification.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to an interface with two mutually constrained operations such as length and copy. Construct a table that satisfies every signature but violates their relation; assess the relation separately. Compare named Rust impl conformance with the C registration and explain why free C functions do not add language extension-method lookup.
criteria.scope: Two-method law and actual Rust comparison
limits: The wrapper detects length disagreement, not arbitrary wrong content with the right length.

criteria.criterion: Derive the two representations and their table/data lifetime and cache costs; distinguish logical two-part dispatch from an ABI promise of exactly two machine words.
criteria.scope: Embedded/pair representation and actual32/64-bit probes
limits: Measured ABI layouts and timing do not imply universal two-word layout or speed.

criteria.criterion: Implement an embedded-to-view adapter preserving concrete receiver address, const access and failure publication.
criteria.scope: Typed embedded receiver and subobject address preservation
limits: Borrowed object and table storage must stay live.

criteria.criterion: Validate both representations against the same direct implementation and compile the double-pointer qualifier counterexample under strict C17; diagnose why one-level qualifier addition does not generalize recursively.
criteria.scope: Equivalent implementation grid and qualifier diagnostics
limits: The strict diagnostic addresses pointer qualification, not all aliasing errors.

criteria.criterion: Compare Rust trait-object representation and lifetime bounds with the C pair, then change to a borrowed subobject and multiple interfaces. Recompute pointer adjustment, owner storage and invalidation; no automatic variance or lifetime proof is inherited. Compile the supplied empty-struct probe under strict C17 and compare a one-byte marker field with the inspected Rust zero-sized marker rules. Record extension diagnostics and actual size separately; no zero-size or no-cost C guarantee follows.
criteria.scope: Multiple borrowed interfaces, marker and lifetime counterexamples
limits: Rust layout observations and C diagnostics do not add lifetime checking to C.

criteria.criterion: Derive the dictionary as explicit operation evidence and state the laws required before reordering or parallelizing a fold.
criteria.scope: Operation laws and nonassociative parallel counterexample
limits: The actual two-thread reduction demonstrates saturation nonassociativity, not general parallel safety.

criteria.criterion: Implement dictionary and specialized forms with identical admission, prefix-overflow and output contracts, maintaining callback order and count.
criteria.scope: Identical dictionary/specialized admission and prefix semantics
limits: Only the stated checked scalar arithmetic and operation order are supported.

criteria.criterion: Exhaust lengths0 through5 over values{-2,0,3} against an independent mathematical fold and failure trace; kill swapped-operand and partial-publication mutants.
criteria.scope: 1092 independent fold traces and mutation controls
limits: The finite alphabet and length bound do not prove all inputs.

criteria.criterion: Measure code size, indirect branches, compilation and inlining under fixed versus runtime-selected dictionaries. Explain why a C macro over concrete types or void-pointer dictionary does not implement Haskell kind checking over a type constructor; give a rejected or unchecked encoding counterexample.
criteria.scope: Dictionary costs and higher-kind enforcement boundary
limits: Concrete C macro/dictionary evidence is not higher-kind quantification.

criteria.criterion: Separate capture-by-value/reference from invocation capabilities and explain the documented Rust rule that move capture alone does not imply only FnOnce.
criteria.scope: Capture mode versus actual Rust invocation capability
limits: The Rust comparison is scoped to the compiled examples and compiler version.

criteria.criterion: Implement the three explicit modes with checked arithmetic, exactly-once consumption and clear borrowed/owned capture lifetimes; add borrowed-slice and owning-resource closures.
criteria.scope: Borrowed slice and owned resource closure lifetime
limits: Caller-managed borrow lifetimes remain a C precondition.

criteria.criterion: Enumerate operation sequences including repeated calls, failed calls, reinitialization under its ownership precondition and copied-state misuse; compare state transitions with an independent finite model.
criteria.scope: 59049 closure transitions, extrema and copied-state misuse
limits: Safe copied arithmetic-state demonstration does not authorize copying live ownership controls.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to a retained asynchronous callback. Establish an environment outlives relation, cancellation ownership and reentrancy policy; show how copying an active C struct defeats a local consumed bit even when every ordinary call checks it.
criteria.scope: Retained asynchronous owning closure with actual T66 owner
limits: One serialized controller; cancellation completion requires join and can wait indefinitely for a nonreturning body.

criteria.criterion: Derive erased-call representation, invocation thunk, ownership and empty states; distinguish byte encoding from placing an arbitrary typed object in character storage.
criteria.scope: Erased byte codec versus arbitrary object representation
limits: Signed scalar encoding is not arbitrary typed object storage.

criteria.criterion: Implement capture construction, explicit movement and no-fail destruction through dod.small_buffer with no duplicated allocator logic, including a spill and failure rollback.
criteria.scope: Actual T70 small buffer and actual T66 allocation adapter
limits: Producer dependency remains T70 to T69; no copied allocator implementation.

criteria.criterion: Inject each allocation/codec failure, test source/destination/self move and repeated drop, and verify exactly-once external destruction plus unchanged outputs on failing calls.
criteria.scope: Allocation/clone prefixes, move and destruction
limits: Failure schedules cover the declared bounded resources and codec.

criteria.criterion: Compare owning C erasure, a borrowed function reference and the documented C++ move_only_function/function_ref contracts. Analyze inline storage, movement constraints and empty invocation without claiming common ABI or universal small-buffer capacity.
criteria.scope: Typed/borrowed/owning capture costs and contract comparisons
limits: No universal C++ ABI, inline capacity or empty-call guarantee is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to a self-referential or over-aligned capture and a callback returning a borrowed reference. Either provide a justified typed representation/relocator/lifetime protocol or reject it explicitly; a byte copy is not a general solution.
criteria.scope: Explicit self-reference/alignment/borrowed-return admission
limits: Unsupported requests are rejected before allocation; declared metadata does not inspect arbitrary object internals.

criteria.criterion: Derive ordered dispatch keys, missing-method behavior, cache coherence and epoch exhaustion; distinguish explicit symmetry from accidental argument normalization.
criteria.scope: Ordered key and epoch coherence derivation
limits: Finite generation exhaustion retires; no wraparound safety claim.

criteria.criterion: Implement registration and cached invocation preserving output on failure; add a two-entry policy with an explicit eviction rule.
criteria.scope: Two-entry FIFO resolution cache
limits: Only the explicit bounded type partial order is modeled.

criteria.criterion: Enumerate all nine type pairs and registration/cache histories, including cached misses, replacement/removal and epoch exhaustion; kill stale-epoch and reversed-pair mutants.
criteria.scope: All pair/update/cache histories and two distinct mutants
limits: Bounded histories do not prove all arbitrary update schedules.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to subtype fallback with two equally specific candidates. Define ambiguity detection and coherence before caching, then compare lookup, code size and update costs under monomorphic and varied call traces.
criteria.scope: Ambiguity before caching and varied-call costs
limits: No accidental tie breaking; measurements remain workload/compiler specific.

criteria.criterion: Prove circular forward/backward invariants, single membership and item/list lifetime; explain why the sentinel is not a DSItem.
criteria.scope: Circular list, sentinel and single-membership invariants
limits: Sentinel and item have distinct admissible representations.

criteria.criterion: Implement bounded insertion/removal and checked traversal using the inspected first-member conversion rule; attach external behavior without assuming an object hierarchy.
criteria.scope: First-member typed conversion and external behavior
limits: All live pointers must refer to the declared typed objects.

criteria.criterion: Enumerate insertion/removal permutations and wrong-list operations, recompute both directions independently and reject omitted-backlink and duplicate-membership mutants.
criteria.scope: Insertion/removal histories and independent backlink recomputation
limits: The original model exhausts eight-operation words of length7, not arbitrary sequences.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to an object with two intrusive hooks and movable surrounding storage. Compare an explicit parent pointer, typed index and platform-specific container recovery; define every invalidation rule and inspect generated code/diagnostics without executing an invalid cast.
criteria.scope: Dual hooks, movable indices and container code probes
limits: Platform container recovery is inspected separately; no invalid cast is executed.

criteria.criterion: Derive public incomplete-type opacity and dependency ownership; distinguish hidden representation, nominal type identity and an unforgeable security boundary.
criteria.scope: Opaque representation versus nominal identity/security
limits: An incomplete C type does not isolate arbitrary writes in one address space.

criteria.criterion: Implement a bounded factory, close protocol and injected-service operation with atomic result publication and explicit irreversible callback effects.
criteria.scope: Factories with actual shared service ownership
limits: Irreversible external callbacks are not rolled back by output staging.

criteria.criterion: Inject failures at each service invocation and exhaust the factory; compile a client attempting private-field access and compare two implementations through one independent contract suite.
criteria.scope: Independent second implementation and all acquisition cuts
limits: 150 contract traces are bounded; no proof of all replacement implementations.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to a parameterized module with correlated key/value types. Explain which relations a typed C facade can enforce and which erased dictionary cannot; compare fixed opaque concrete return identity with runtime existential selection and state why neither is reproduced merely by returning void*.
criteria.scope: Correlated typed maps and opaque concrete identity
limits: Erased void-pointer APIs do not inherit the correlated type facade constraints.

criteria.criterion: State the authority graph, permitted attacker actions and property: delegated rights remain a subset and revoked epochs cannot authorize a new effect. Distinguish a cooperative token from an unforgeable capability.
criteria.scope: Attacker authority, rights subset and epoch model
limits: Only original local broker processes and synthetic counters are targeted.

criteria.criterion: Implement subset admission, owner/epoch validation, bounded revocation and checked effect publication without global ambient authority.
criteria.scope: Bounded grant/revoke and staged synthetic effects
limits: Inherited local connection identity is not a general remote authentication protocol.

criteria.criterion: Enumerate all rights masks, owner pairs and epoch transitions; demonstrate harmless unauthorized-counter change in the two explicit mutants and regression rejection in the repair.
criteria.scope: Rights/epoch enumeration and actual harmless mutant effects
limits: Counter changes demonstrate only the stated authorization violation.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to delegation across an actual process boundary with opaque server-side IDs. Define authentication, replay, ID reuse, revocation and confused-deputy behavior, and show why a hidden C struct alone does not solve arbitrary in-process writes.
criteria.scope: Actual process boundary, replay and confused deputy
limits: No claims about resistance to host compromise, hostile shared-library code or deployed services.

criteria.criterion: Separate ISO object/function pointer rules, the target ABI and Linux loader semantics, including dlsym error handling, constructor effects and logical invalidation after close.
criteria.scope: ISO/ABI/loader separation and observed constructor effects
limits: Constructor side effects happen before ABI admission; no sandbox is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Implement failure-clean loading, exact version/size admission and borrowed-code quiescence using a typed exported object; define trusted fixture extent rather than pretending a size field proves memory validity.
criteria.scope: Failure-clean exact/base-prefix admission and code leases
limits: Trusted original DSO extent is a precondition; a size field does not prove memory validity.

criteria.criterion: Run original good/bad/missing-symbol/size fixtures under GCC/Clang sanitizers, verify each acquisition prefix and reject ignored-version and premature-close mutants by intended assertions before an invalid call.
criteria.scope: Ten original DSO variants and intended mutation rejection
limits: No invalid function pointer or released code is intentionally called.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to an ABI with optional trailing methods and independently built clients. Specify common-prefix compatibility, alignment/calling-convention/version negotiation and code/data allocator ownership; test with separate shared libraries and record unsupported ABI combinations.
criteria.scope: Independently built client/DSO compatibility matrix
limits: Eight same-platform GCC/Clang pairings do not establish other platform ABIs.

criteria.criterion: Derive prepare/commit/retire states and the quiescence condition covering every borrowed code/data pointer; distinguish rejected migration from committed reload with pending cleanup.
criteria.scope: Prepare/commit/retire and acknowledgement ownership
limits: A canceled operation can still own executable code until actual completion and join.

criteria.criterion: Implement staged migration, source ownership consumption, finite generations and explicit retired collection, preserving the old service on every precommit failure.
criteria.scope: Staged variable-size migration with two registration cuts
limits: At most one current and one retired slot; finite generation exhaustion is explicit.

criteria.criterion: Explore reload/borrow/release/collect/fail sequences against an independent ownership/state model, verifying no duplicated or lost handle and no state publication before migration succeeds.
criteria.scope: 63 independent failure rows and actual queued/running histories
limits: A deterministic close gate models fallibility without manufacturing an invalid loader handle.

criteria.criterion: Transfer to asynchronous plugin callbacks and owned variable-size state. Define snapshot/serialization, cancellation acknowledgement, allocator boundaries and bounded retirement; measure pause time and retained resources without claiming transparent live-code replacement.
criteria.scope: Real T70/T66 state, callbacks, retention and pause samples
limits: 160 samples are observations, not a worst-case pause or transparent live-code replacement guarantee.

criteria.criterion: Derive a final-style program as operations over semantic carriers; distinguish integer and integer-function carriers from a universal tagged value and from higher-kind quantification.
criteria.scope: Typed semantic carriers and final-style program
limits: The one-binder fragment is not a general higher-kind type checker.

criteria.criterion: Implement distinct evaluation and rendering dictionaries, borrowed function contexts, staged failures and one shared higher-order program without an interpreter library.
criteria.scope: Distinct evaluation/rendering dictionaries and staged failure
limits: Evaluation contexts are borrowed through the last call; rendering owns bounded copied text.

criteria.criterion: Compare exact results, renderings and callback schedules against an independent model; reject incompatible carrier translations and semantic mutation controls.
criteria.scope: Independent results/traces and incompatible carrier probes
limits: 119 finite oracle cases and compiled controls do not prove all programs.

criteria.criterion: Transfer the same term to callback failure and bounded textual output; classify lifetime, purity, arithmetic and type-enforcement limits and produce the13-dimension cost evidence.
criteria.scope: Failure/output transfer and thirteen cost dimensions
limits: No general impure interpreter or universal zero-cost abstraction claim.

limitations: No finite campaign proves absolute mastery.
No independent learner or human reviewer acceptance is asserted.
The recorded earlier TSan harness failure remains in dispatch_campaign_pre_quiescence_harness_fix.json; the final campaign includes the joined-worker correction.
